description: TEST preview for original Maps Automotive 26.10.120001.E (1068833407, ARM64). All preview 3 features moved to 26.10, steering-wheel zoom kept after a car restart, CCS1 in the vehicle profile, experimental Android 10 / DiLink 3 (with automatic cluster resume) and DiLink 5.1 support. MicroG-RE 7.2.1 tested; own signing key required. For 26.09.280001.E use preview 3. See release notes for setup and verification limits.
